issue_context.title: vicare integration listing gas consumption as kWh where it should be m³
issue_context.body:
### The problem

The gas consumption sensors in sensor.py have unit of measurement kWh. However, the android vicare app lists the same amount as having unit m³. 
When I compare the value to my gas meter I also think the value is m³ and not kWh.
I am using a very recent vitodens 200.

```
    SENSOR_DHW_GAS_CONSUMPTION_TODAY: {
        CONF_NAME: "Hot water gas consumption today",
        CONF_ICON: "mdi:power",
        CONF_UNIT_OF_MEASUREMENT: ENERGY_KILO_WATT_HOUR,
        CONF_GETTER: lambda api: api.getGasConsumptionDomesticHotWaterToday(),
        CONF_DEVICE_CLASS: None,
    },
```

Perhaps for some viessmann devices it's kWh and for others m³...?

### What is version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

2021.2.1

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Container

### Integration causing the issue

vicare

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/vicare/

### Example YAML snippet

_No response_

### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

_No response_

### Additional information

_No response_
comments:
Hey there @oischinger, mind taking a look at this issue as its been labeled with an integration (`vicare`) you are listed as a [codeowner](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/CODEOWNERS#L535) for? Thanks!
<sub><sup>(message by CodeOwnersMention)</sup></sub>

Here's what my app shows me:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7779765/120230896-8afde780-c250-11eb-8c61-3fc32deef692.png)
which corresponds to what I have in HA:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7779765/120230946-a668f280-c250-11eb-91cb-e37a6bbe850c.png)

This is really weird. I couldn't find a setting in the app to switch the units for kWh vs m³. 

Actually m³ would make more sense to me because that's the only thing the heater can accurately measure. kWh must me an appoximation e.g. m³ * 10

Which app are you using? ViCare or Vitotrol plus?

Hi Hans,

both the vicare app and vitoguide website list it as m³ for me.
The numbers listed in the app are the same as the numbers listed in home assistant, only HA defines them (incorrectly, as far as I can see) as in kWh.

The app shows two things for my installation: "gas consumption" which is listed in m³ and "energy balance" which is listed in kWh.
In my vitodens 200 I can configure the calirometric value for a cubic metre of gas in a parameter. This is how the boiler calculates the amount of kWh from its measurements in m³.

To me it seems like the "vicare heating gas consumption" value should have m³ instead of kWh as quantity.
But it is also possible the api returns a value in a different quantity depending on your installation. In that case perhaps the code could query the api to determine the right quantity: either m³ or kwh?
I'm using a Vitodens 200-W and the ViCare App also schows m³ as measurement unit.

Does the m3 also apply to all other gas sensors it provides? (e.g., month, day, year, and so on?)
Or are the smaller time frames (e.g., today) having for example cm3?

@frenck In the ViCare App, every gas consumption (today,week, month, year) is shown as m³ for me.

In Home Assistant, the same value is shown but as kWh.

The information I got so far is that the app is switching over to kWh. Previously it was m3.
It would be good to have a dump of the information the API gives you. See https://github.com/somm15/PyViCare for how to generate that.
All the contributed jsons show kWh so far.

Turns out that some systems report kWh and others report m³.
Here's an example of m³ https://github.com/somm15/PyViCare/blob/master/tests/response/Vitodens200W.json ("value": "cubicMeter")
All the others seem to be in kWh ("value": "kilowattHour")

I opened an issue in the underlying  PyVicare library project:
https://github.com/somm15/PyViCare/issues/193

We need to resolve this first before adressing it in Home Assistant

I created a PR on the custom component's repository which should respect the units at least for gas boilers.
Would be great if someone who sees m³ in his app could check it out:
https://github.com/oischinger/ha_vicare/pull/62

Works for me. Unit in HA is now shown as m³ and I could choose the ViCare sensors as source for the energy dashboard.

Thank you! @oischinger

Great. thanks for the quick feedback.
Will need to wait a bit until I can contribute this to Home Assistant however.

review_comments: The energy device class is not allowed to have Watt as unit of measurement.
The return value of the unit getter doesn't seem to be boolean. It returns a unit of measurement, right?
It's enough to check for truthy. We don't need to check for Callable. The type is either Callable or None.
